title: Growing up in the 7th Ward among the Tios, Picou and Big Eye
summary: He was born at Prairie and La Perouse and lists which street corners Big Eye Louis, Picou and the Tios lived on.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What part of town were you born in? Were you born right here in the city of New Orleans?

In the 7th Ward. That's why I moved back down here. I'm born right there. Prairie and La Perouse. You heard Big Iloy? Oh yes you heard man. I was living in the middle of the block. Big Iloy was living at that corner. Pico was living around the corner. Lorenzo Teo was living two blocks from me. Papa Teo was living a block and a half this way from me. I was right in them.

I don't like to bother you with all those details but if we can figure out where some of those fellas lived. Like Big I. Now what corner was that on about? Which street? Like Big Iloy. Just which street?

Prairie between La Perouse and Unzago. Then I was on Prairie between La Perouse and La Hoppe. You see he was to that block and I was to this block. Papaya Teo was living in La Hoppe and Durban. Lorenzo Teo was living on Columbus between Prairie and Roman. And Pico. Where was Pico? Pico was living on Johnson near St. Bernard. We was right there in the neighborhood. Half a block and a block apart.
